package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/middleware"
)

const relationAccessQueryParam = "via_relation_id"

// optionalLessonReadAccess distinguishes an omitted update field (preserve the
// existing override) from an explicit null (clear it and inherit).
type optionalLessonReadAccess struct {
	Set   bool
	Value *domain.LessonReadAccess
}

func (o *optionalLessonReadAccess) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	o.Set = true
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &o.Value); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return domain.ValidateLessonReadAccess(o.Value)
}

func isPrivilegedRequest(r *http.Request) bool {
	_, role, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	return ok && isPositionPrivilegedRole(role)
}

func writeContentAccessError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	var accessErr *domain.LessonReadAccessError
	if errors.As(err, &accessErr) {
		status := http.StatusForbidden
		if accessErr.Code == "lesson_authentication_required" {
			status = http.StatusUnauthorized
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(status)
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
			"error": map[string]any{
				"code":            accessErr.Code,
				"required_access": accessErr.Required,
			},
		})
		return
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
}
